The passing rollouts use the phrase "shared personnel tracker" verbatim; rollout 2 omits that phrase entirely (saying only "Enter the updated radio-console qualification roster"), and rollout 3 uses "shared personnel tracker" but structures the commitment differently (type "follow_up_task" with detail "entering Sgt. Hale's updated qualification roster in the shared personnel tracker"). This is an ENCODING MISMATCH: the check C4 appears to require a specific phrasing or commitment structure that the model does not consistently produce even when it has correctly received and used PF1. The information was revealed, cited, and the decision value is correct — the check is failing on wording/structural details of the commitment field rather than on substantive use of the fact. No other checks failed; C1, C2, C3, C5, and P1 all passed in all 4 rollouts. No rollouts hit the turn cap (auto_failed_count is 0; turn counts are 3, 3, 6, and 7).
